{{Otheruses|Rock}}
'''Rock wart sting juice''' was a poison naturally occurring in the [[Rock wart/Legends|rock wart]] creatures of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When delivered in powdered form, the substance could be quite harmful.

[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] often carried dried rock wart sting juice.
